categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Anli Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, sales, and service of ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather and composite materials. Its main products include ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather and related composite materials, serving industries such as functional footwear, sofa home furnishings, automotive interiors, electronics, sports equipment, and engineering decoration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including water-based, solvent-free, TPU, bio-based, silicon-based, and recycled materials in its production. It employs flexible manufacturing systems driven by sales orders, integrating polyurethane resin production with synthetic leather manufacturing. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon, and ecological production methods, supported by automation, informatization, and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic high-end brands such as Nike, Adidas, Puma, Anta, Li Ning, Apple, Toyota, BYD, and Decathlon. The company serves diverse markets including functional footwear, sofa home furnishings, automotive interiors, consumer electronics, and sports equipment, with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province, and has significant overseas operations through subsidiaries in Vietnam and Russia. It exports products globally, including developed countries, and leverages Vietnam's strategic location for international trade advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Anli operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of polyurethane synthetic leather and composite materials. It integrates upstream polyurethane resin production and downstream product customization and sales, positioning itself as a key supplier to brand manufacturers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance, multifunctional, ecological, and green materials. It invests over 4% of annual revenue in R&D, focusing on water-based, solvent-free, TPU, bio-based, silicon-based, and recycled materials. Strategic R&D projects target product upgrades for footwear, sofa home furnishings, electronics, automotive interiors, and sustainable materials development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ecological functional polyurethane synthetic leather and composite materials. The company employs a sales model dominated by direct sales to brand customers and their designated OEMs, supplemented by authorized distributors. Revenue streams include product sales domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anhui Anli is a leading global player in the polyurethane synthetic leather industry, recognized as the largest scale producer in China and a national manufacturing champion. It holds a top position in domestic market share and mid-to-high-end segments, with strong brand recognition and technological leadership. Competitors include other synthetic leather manufacturers primarily in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and Fujian provinces.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.4 billion, a 20.12% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 194 million, up 174.19%. It maintains strong asset base with total assets over RMB 2.4 billion and equity of RMB 1.4 billion. The company shows a robust growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes ecological functionality, high performance, and green manufacturing in its products, offering superior aesthetics, durability, and environmental compliance compared to traditional PVC synthetic leather. It differentiates through advanced water-based and solvent-free technologies, integrated polyurethane resin production, and customized solutions for high-end global brands, ensuring competitive advantages in quality, innovation, and sustainability.
